parameters.query:
-- Get domains that have sitemap URLs but may have missed child sitemaps
-- Focus on domains that have sitemap URLs in pages table
SELECT DISTINCT d.id as domain_id, d.domain
FROM wellness.domains d
JOIN wellness.pages p ON p.domain_id = d.id
WHERE p.page_type = 'sitemap'
  AND d.domain IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.domain
LIMIT 50;

-- Get all sitemap URLs for this domain
SELECT url FROM wellness.pages
WHERE domain_id = $1::uuid AND page_type = 'sitemap'
ORDER BY url;

INSERT INTO wellness.pages (domain_id, url, page_type)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, 'content')
ON CONFLICT (domain_id, url) DO UPDATE SET 
  last_seen_at = NOW(),
  page_type = CASE 
    WHEN wellness.pages.url ILIKE '%sitemap%' THEN 'sitemap'
    WHEN wellness.pages.url ILIKE '%.jpg' OR wellness.pages.url ILIKE '%.png' OR wellness.pages.url ILIKE '%.gif' THEN 'image'
    ELSE 'content'
  END;
